title: Mid-Range Gaming Rig
description: 1440p gaming powerhouse with excellent thermals and RGB accents.
details:
This build was designed for smooth 1440p gaming at high settings. We prioritized a cool-running CPU and a case with strong airflow, then added subtle RGB for a clean desk setup.

The customer wanted something that could handle modern AAA titles and double as a daily driver without sounding like a jet engine.

title: Creator Workstation
description: Built for video editing and 3D rendering with whisper-quiet cooling.
details: A workstation-focused build with extra RAM and fast storage for Premiere Pro and Blender. Noise was a top priority — we used a quiet air cooler and fan curve tuning so it stays near-silent under typical editing loads.

title: Budget Office & Study PC
description: Fast, reliable, and energy-efficient — perfect for school and everyday work.
details: An affordable system for homework, browsing, and light productivity. Integrated graphics kept costs down while still delivering a snappy Windows experience with an NVMe boot drive.

title: Compact ITX Build
description: Small form factor with full-size performance — fits anywhere.
details: Full gaming performance in a compact ITX chassis. Cable management and thermals were carefully planned so this small box still runs cool during long gaming sessions.
